senses.definition: The people living within a political or geographical boundary.
senses.example: The population of New Jersey will not stand for this!

senses.definition: The people with a given characteristic.
senses.example: India has the third-largest population of English-speakers in the world.

senses.definition: A count of the number of residents within a political or geographical boundary such as a town, a nation or the world.
A collection of organisms of a particular species, sharing a particular characteristic of interest, most often that of living in a given area.
senses.example: A seasonal migration annually changes the populations in two or more biotopes drastically, many twice in opposite senses.

senses.definition: A group of units (persons, objects, or other items) enumerated in a census or from which a sample is drawn.
senses.example: […]it is possible it [the Anglo-Saxon race] might stand second to the Scandinavian countries [in average height] if a fair sample of their population were obtained.

senses.definition: The act of filling initially empty items in a collection.
senses.example: John clicked the Search button and waited for the population of the list to complete.
I would like to say something about the place I am doing time at. When I was placed in population, I met another woman and we immediately became good friends.
